text:
noah: Hey team — opened a PR with tracing hooks and dashboard tiles for KV cache hits + per-model token latency. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5423. Can someone take a quick look? We'd like this merged before tomorrow's canary at 10am PT.

maya: On it, linking Samir and Rachel for metrics and Devon for the dashboard layout. Is CI currently green?

samir: Skimming now. High-level looks fine. Small nit: metric name uses dots (`redwood.kv.cache_hit`) — do we want dots or underscores? Consistency with Prometheus matters.

rachel: I generally prefer underscores for Prom compatibility. Also, is `model_variant` label going to explode cardinality?

devon: Dashboard looks sensible, but agree with Rachel — per-model breakdown could be high-cardinality. Can we sample or only show top-x models?

noah: Good points. I added `model_variant` label for useful breakdowns but we can sample low-volume models at 1%. CI last run shows `dev-ci/5423 — passed` locally.

ci-bot: Build success — unit + integration tests passed (run id: ci/5423).

maya: Can you add a feature flag for enabling the KV tracing in Dedicated/Private? Don't want extra metrics on all installs by default.

samir: Also please add a short note in the rollout docs about fallback if the trace hook throws (we should not bubble errors to callers).

noah: Will do both. Plan: 1) rename metric to `redwood_kv_cache_hit_total`, 2) add env flag `ENABLE_KV_TRACING=false` (off by default), 3) add sampling logic for low-volume models, 4) update rollout doc. Pushing small commits now. Sample config snippet I'm adding:

```
# env/example.env
ENABLE_KV_TRACING=false
KV_TRACING_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01
```

devon: That sampling approach sounds good. Once you rename the metric and add the flag, I'm happy to approve.

rachel: :thumbsup: sampling + flag addresses my concerns.

noah: Pushed commits and updated PR description with the rollout note. Triggering CI.

ci-bot: CI queued... Build #12345 running.

maya: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If CI is green, can someone merge during the 2pm merge window? I'm OOO tomorrow morning.

samir: I'll be online at 2pm — can merge if green.

ci-bot: Build success — all tests passed. Mergeable.

devon: Approving now. /approve

rachel: Approved.

noah: Thanks everyone — will merge at 14:00 PT today. If anything unexpected pops up I'll post an update here.
